verdict.rationale: Zamzar is a file-conversion API, so reporting why a conversion failed is a fair axis. The evidence pack only shows submitting jobs to the jobs endpoint and waiting for them to complete. Nothing documents a failed job status, error codes, or failure reasons such as unsupported features or corrupt input.

support.subject: As a developer, a failed conversion reports why it failed (unsupported feature, corrupt input) instead of silently emitting a broken file
